typography.instructions: Use Space Grotesk for all major headings. Never use Inter/Roboto for headings. Emphasize large, editorial typography with generous line-height for body text. Use Outfit for body to maintain a geometric clean tech look.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous whitespace. Break out of the box. Use asymmetric grids.
grid_patterns: Asymmetric 2-column: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with content spanning col-span-5 and images/graphics col-span-7
Bento grids for features: tight gaps (gap-4), no shadows, 1px subtle borders
Editorial list: massive left padding, clear typography hierarchy, numbers as accents

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-[#003262] text-white hover:bg-[#003262]/90, px-8 py-4, transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: Ghost or subtle outline, text-[#003262] border-[#003262]/20 hover:bg-[#003262]/5

component_patterns.cards: Barely-there borders (border-border/50), huge padding (p-8 md:p-12), flat (no shadow), subtle background shifts (bg-white to bg-gray-50).
component_patterns.navigation: Sticky, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90, 1px bottom border. Clean links, active states highlighted with Cyan underline. Never use complete transparent background.
component_patterns.footer: Dark theme (bg-[#00162B] text-white), massive brand wordmark, minimalistic link columns, standards row with opacity-50 logos.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Berkeley Blue text on Off-White is excellent.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='home-cta-button').

media.philosophy: Use high-quality product abstract renders or clean UI mockups. No generic stock photos.

rules: No AI slop: avoid generic glowing gradients, standard boxy card grids.
Never center-align large blocks of text. Stick to left-aligned for editorial feel.
Use 1px subtle borders (border-collapse style) for tech/data sections.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Use solid or blurred glass.
Use Shadcn UI but aggressively strip the 'Vercel default' look (replace Inter with Space Grotesk/Outfit, use pill buttons).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON thoroughly before implementing any page.
This project uses .js/.jsx files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components using JSX/JS.
Prioritize typography: Use Space Grotesk for headings and Outfit for body.
Implement a robust layout with 'sticky' elements where appropriate to emulate modern editorial sites (MIPS.com).
Ensure all color variables map to the brand's exact hex codes.
Apply 'data-testid' to every button, link, and form input.
Do NOT add emojis into your file creations unless specifically required by the design.

design: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where necessary.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
components: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
